title: Add two numbers
statementMd: Write a function `add(a, b)` that returns the sum of two numbers.
hints: Make sure you `return` the value instead of printing it.
solutionMd:
```python
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
```

`return` hands the value back to the caller; `print` would only display it.
referenceSolution:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
